## Parsing notes

- A full index of every item id would be far too long; this file lists only the PSoul-relevant subsets that can be detected from configs or from the script an id is registered to.
- `items.xml` is read with regular expressions (`id`, `fromid`/`toid` ranges, nested `<attribute>`), comments stripped. `actions.xml` / `movements.xml` id lists are expanded exactly like `parseIntegerVec` (`server/src/tools.cpp`).
- Category membership by script name is heuristic (e.g. a script name containing "potion").
